description: This file contains functions and variables used for platform-specific upgrade operations, including boot device detection, image validation, and firmware update procedures for the STM32 target in an OpenWrt environment.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Detects and exports the boot device by matching UUIDs from the kernel command line and sysfs.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies if the provided image's partition layout matches the current disk layout before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the actual upgrade process, including writing the new image to the disk and preserving u-boot environment.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the new boot partition after upgrade.
